items.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off

items.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
items.summary: Core inflation in Japan soared to a fresh high in 2026, coming in at 2.2% in October as higher energy costs and their knock-on effects pushed up prices in the wider economy.
